texts.facts: 2. When the matter came up for consideration, this Court passed an interim order staying the further proceedings pursuant to Ext.P4, for a period of 45 days subject to the condition that the petitioner shall pay the entire amounts of rent within a period of one month. The basic issue involved in this case pertains to the stop memo issued by the 1st respondent as 2025:KER:94917 per Ext.P4, preventing the petitioner from conducting the shop, in the premises of the 1 st respondent, which was rented out to the petitioner. According to the 1 st respondent the period is already expired on 01.08.2025. Thereafter the petitioner was granted an extension and the said extended period also expired during the month of October 2025.
